listingTitle: Commit a lockfile for Rust binaries
title: Commit a lockfile for Rust binaries
why: A binary without an applicable Cargo.lock can resolve different transitive dependencies across builds and miss review of the deployed dependency set.
suggestion: Generate and commit Cargo.lock at the package or workspace root, then build with --locked or --frozen.
limitations: Default src/main.rs targets and explicit Cargo bin targets are recognized.
Workspace membership is approximated by accepting a lockfile in an ancestor directory.
